demos.title: Mandelbrot Set
demos.pitch: Explore the fractal boundary defined by iteration of z ↦ z² + c in the complex plane. Pan and zoom to examine its self-similar structure.

demos.title: Prime Number Sieve
demos.pitch: A real-time visualization of the Sieve of Eratosthenes, illustrating the elimination of composite numbers to isolate the primes.

demos.title: Fourier Series
demos.pitch: Construct periodic waveforms as sums of rotating phasors, illustrating how harmonic components combine to approximate arbitrary signals.

demos.title: Collatz Conjecture
demos.pitch: Trace the trajectory of any positive integer under the 3n + 1 iteration. Whether every sequence reaches 1 remains an open problem.
